ISIS promise to conquer Rome and wipe out Jews in chilling propaganda video | World | News

'You will pay a high price' ISIS promises to conquer Rome & wipe out Jews in chilling clip


ISLAMIC State militants have warned they are targeting Jewish people, Rome, Israel and Egypt in a chilling new video.

00:45, Thu, Aug 4, 2016 Updated: 01:14, Thu, Aug 4, 2016

AFP/ GETTY

ISIS have promised to take Rome and target Jews in their latest propaganda clip

The footage, which is believed to have been released by terrorists in Egypt's Sinai peninsula, shows the influence the depraved terror group has is spreading further afield.

The clip, which was released on Monday, shows jihadis from the death-cult's wing in Sinai – known as Wilayat Sinai – promising to conquer Rome and take aim at Israel.

> This is only the beginning, and our meeting will be in Rome
> 
> Islamic State

Titled Desert Flame, the video shows Egyptian military targets being attacked by the heinous death cult.

The voiceover can be heard discussing past attacks in the Sinai region and how the twisted killers will continue to target westerners.

According to a translator from the Middle East Research Institute, the jihadi says: "This is only the beginning, and our meeting will be in Rome and Beit Al-Maqdis (Jerusalem).


Flashmob spark TERROR alert as group mistaken for ISIS

"Oh Jews, wait for us. The punishment [we have prepared for you] is severe and soon you will pay a high price."

It comes as a supergrass from the terror cult revealed the group were planning simultaneous attacks across Britain, France and Germany.

British-educated Harry Sarfo, originally from Germany, travelled to Syria but commanders for the heinous group told him to return to Europe to prepare a terror attack.

GETTY

ISIS promised to attack Israel

After suffering heavy defeats in Syria and Iraq over the past few months, Sinai has become an increasingly important area for Daesh.

In April, 12 jihadis left Gaza to join the ISIS wing in the region and last month Israel conducted several drone strikes on terrorists in the peninsula, according to a former Israeli official.

NC

ISIS release chilling propaganda on a regular basis

Researchers at the Information Handling Service said the death cult has lost a quarter of its entire territory over the past 18 months.

ISIS-controlled territory dwindled from 35,000 square miles in January 2015 to 26,370 square miles.

The Arab-Israeli War, also known as the Final Intifada, is a conflict involving Israel and nearby Arab nations, such as Syria, Egypt and Palestine, following the First European War.


Start of the conflict

The war can begin in two ways: If Russia wins the First European War, then a month after Hamas will take over all of Palestine, declaring the "Final intifada" soon after, or, If NATO wins then, it will be Assad's Syria that attacks Israel, forming the Damascus Pact, a temporary alliance initially composed by Palestine, Syria and Hezbollah, though it will still be formed if Hamas takes control of Palestine.


Escalation

After a few months following the Syrian intervention, Egypt will also attack Israel. If the Nile River Coalition still exists, it will be called to war, and within months, the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan will join the war and the Damascus Pact. If Israel successfully occupies the entire Sinai, it will force Egypt to withdraw from the war and sign a truce,


Result


Arab victory

If the Arabs are next to defeating Israel, the IDF will enact the "Samson option", nuking the capitals of hostile nations, such as Baghdad, Tehran, and Damascus. After the State of Israel capitulates, Palestine will annex it, ceding the Golan Heights to Syria.


Compromise

If the war goes on for more than 700 days, then a ceasefire will be ratified between the Arabs Nations and Israel, thus making a two-state solution.

Israel will have to withdraw from the Palestinian lands in Gaza, the West bank of the Jordan river and also return the Golan Heights to Syria.


Israeli victory

In case Israel survives, then it will pursue the biggest expansion in its history.

It will annex both the Gaza strip and the West Bank, putting an end to the Palestinian state, and Jordan, while the Sinai Peninsula, The state of Daara and southern Lebanon will be taken over by Israel.

The defeat in Israel will also make Syria fall into another civil war between the Syrian Arab Republic, the Syrian Republic, the Syrian Interim Government and the Kurdish Worker's Republic, the latter of whom will then unite with Iraqi Kurdistan if it still exists.

Le conflit peut débuter en 2027 suite à la Première Guerre européenne selon la victoire de la Russie ou de l'OTAN. Le résultat de la guerre peut mener à une victoire arabe, un compromis (cessez-le-feu) ou une victoire israélienne.

webpage.text:
Frente Norte: 3 divisiones del ejercito israelí se instalan en frontera con Líbano

Ante la posibilidad de ataques de la milicia chiita Hezbolá a territorios controlados por el Estado de Israel, la entidad ocupante a movilizado parte sus fuerzas armadas a las cercanías del Líbano, dividiendo a sus fuerzas que se preparan para una posible incursión en Gaza.

Por Joaquín Pérez

El vicesecretario general de Hezbolá, Sheij Qassem, aseguró a los medios de comunicación en el Líbano que su organización ha entrado en “al corazón de la batalla” y que el ejército israelí ha desplazado al frente norte de los territorios que controla a “tres divisiones para contenerles”. De otra forma, estarían junto a las cinco que se preparan para entrar en Gaza.

La situación en el frente norte israelí es de gran tención y con dosificación de las acciones militares por ambos bandos, tanto Israel como Hezbolá, midiendo sus acciones, escalando de forma gradual el conflicto. El Estado de Israel ya ha retirado a los civiles de varias ciudades y enclaves del norte, ante los intensos bombardeos de que son objeto por parte de Hezbolá y a su vez atacan posiciones de esta organización en el sur libanés.

Te puede interesar: Asoladores ataques israelíes han dejado 5.795 muertes y 18.000 personas heridas en Gaza y Cisjordania, indican cifras oficiales

En los últimos días la entidad sionista ha bombardeado los aeropuertos sirios, además de instalaciones militares de aquella nación árabe, mientras milicias del denominado Eje De La Resistencia, han atacado bases militares estadounidenses en Siria e Irak.

Estados Unidos y el Estado de Israel culpan a Irán de estar detrás de los distintos grupos de resistencia y se teme que el conflicto de Gaza se expanda a uno regional en todo Asia Occidental.

Israel ha amenazado al Líbano con arrasarlo nuevamente si no contiene a las milicias de Hezbolá. Sin embargo, aquel país parece estar ya inmunizado a las amenazas israelíes, numerosas concentraciones de apoyo a Palestina se han vivido estos días en aquel país, donde participan no sólo los grupos chiitas próximos a Hezbolá y los palestinos refugiados, sino también libaneses de otras denominaciones étnicas y religiosas.

Palestinos en el Líbano

Desde la ofensiva de Hamás, se vive una agitación en la docena de campos de refugiados de palestinos en el Líbano, donde habitan hacinados y en condiciones de pobreza, más de 400.000 personas de Palestina. La rabia y la indignación frente al genocidio israelí, se mezclan con un sentimiento de euforia y optimismo, ante el derrumbe del mito de invisibilidad del ejército sionista tras el golpe dado por Hamás. Aunque tradicionalmente los refugiados palestinos en el Líbano son políticamente más cercanos a los partidos de la Organización para la Liberación de Palestina (OLP), la ofensiva liderada por los islamistas palestinos desde la Franja de Gaza parece haber obtenido un apoyo unánime.

Le vicesecretario general del Hezbollah, Sheij Qassem, déclare que son organisation est entrée au cœur de la bataille. L'article mentionne également des bombardements israéliens sur le Liban, la Syrie, ainsi que 5 795 morts et 18 000 blessés à Gaza et en Cisjordanie. Des milices de l'Eje De La Resistencia ont attaqué des bases américaines en Syrie et en Irak, et plus de 400 000 réfugiés palestiniens vivent dans des camps au Liban.

webpage.text:
İsrail'den Türkiye Dahil 52 Ülkeye 'Şer Ekseni'nde Olma Suçlaması

Türkiye’nin girişimiyle 52 ülkenin imzaladığı ve Birleşmiş Milletler’e sunulan İsrail’e silah ambargosu uygulanmasına yönelik çağrıyı içeren mektuba İsrail cephesinden yanıt geldi.

İsrail'in Birleşmiş Milletler (BM) Daimî Temsilcisi Danny Danon, 52 ülke ile birlikte İsrail'a silah ambargosu uygulanmasını talep eden Türkiye'yi "kötü niyetli" olmakla suçladı. Danon, Türkiye ile ilgili, "Eylemlerinin motivasyonu, şer eksenindeki diğer ülkelerin de desteğini alarak çatışmalar yaratmak olan bir ülkeden başka ne beklenebilir?" dedi.


BM’ye sunulan 52 ülkenin imzasının bulunduğu mejtunu "Şer ekseninin, uluslararası sahnede İsrail'e karşı gülünç bir eylemi" olarak anan Danon, BM’nin de "adalet ve etik değerleri savunan liberal devletler tarafından değil, kötü niyetli ülkeler tarafından" yönlendirildiği savunmasında bulundu.

Danon, İsrail’in çıkarları için "her türlü siyasi ve askeri saldırıya karşı" mücadele vermeye devam edeceğini söyledi.


MEKTUPTA İMZASI BULUNAN ÜLKELER

Söz konusu mektubu imzalayan ülkeler arasında şunlar yer alıyor:

Türkiye, Filistin, Bahreyn, Bangladeş, Birleşik Arap Emirlikleri, Bolivya, Brezilya, Brunei Darusselam, Burkina Faso, Cezayir, Cibuti, Çin Halk Cumhuriyeti, Endonezya, Fas, Gambiya, Güney Afrika, Irak, İran, Katar, Kazakistan, Kırgızistan, Kolombiya, Komorlar Birliği, Kuveyt, Küba, Libya, Lübnan, Maldivler, Malezya, Meksika, Mısır, Moritanya, Namibya, Nijerya, Nikaragua, Norveç, Pakistan, Rusya, Saint Vincent ve Grenadinler, Sao Tome ve Principe, Senegal, Somali, Sudan, Suudi Arabistan, Şili, Tunus, Umman, Ürdün, Venezuela, Vietnam, Yemen ve Zimbabve.

resultats_lens.texte_contexte: Un article de Gerçek Gündem indique que l'ambassadeur d'Israël auprès des Nations Unies, Danny Danon, a qualifié de « malveillante » et d'« acte ridicule » une initiative de la Turquie signée par 52 pays appelant à un embargo sur les armes contre Israël et présentée à l'ONU. Danon a accusé la Turquie d'agir avec le soutien de pays faisant partie d'un « axe du mal ». La liste des pays signataires comprend notamment la Turquie, la Palestine, la Chine, la Russie, l'Afrique du Sud, le Brésil et d'autres nations.
